title: Senior Product Manager - Cybersecurity
description:
**About us**
------------



The physical and digital worlds are merging. Vehicles, medical devices, industrial systems, critical infrastructure: security hasn't kept pace. AI is accelerating everything, from the capabilities of the systems we depend on to the sophistication of the threats targeting them. A software vulnerability can now have physical consequences. A physical breach can compromise entire digital ecosystems. Billions of devices operate with little to no protection, and traditional approaches can't keep up. Not at this scale, not at this speed, and not across this diversity of systems.  

Exein exists to solve this. We build the security layer for a world where physical and digital threats are no longer separate problems, from runtime protection on embedded devices to cloud-native platforms that analyze, protect, and prove compliance across entire device fleets. We're not patching the old model. We're building security from the core out.


**The role**
------------



We're looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to lead 1-2 key product verticals within the Exein platform, covering our core products — Analyzer and Runtime — and setting new benchmarks in physical AI security.  

**This is a high-ownership role for someone who has already built and scaled products within a cybersecurity scale-up in Europe or elsewhere.** We are specifically looking with someone with a demonstrated founder mentality, for example ex founders, early product hires, or a first/sole Product Manager who has operated in a fast-growing cybersecurity company and knows what it takes to turn complex technical challenges into successful products.  

This role requires a business innovation mindset applied to a highly technical context. You will drive a dedicated product vertical end-to-end, with accountability for its strategic direction and execution across the associated roadmap pillars — from customer discovery and problem definition to product strategy, prioritization, development, launch, and continuous improvement.  

You will work closely with the head of product to provide input on overall product strategy and the platform roadmap to meet the needs of your vertical. Working across a highly cross-functional environment, you will collaborate closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Security Research, AI, and Go-to-Market teams. You will work as an integral part of Exein's Product organization, collaborating closely with the Product Team based at our headquarters in Rome, Italy. The role reports to the Head of Product, who reports to the CTO. While this role is based in Europe, occasional travel to Rome will be required to ensure strong alignment, close collaboration, and shared product ownership.  

We need someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates with exceptional autonomy, and can take a product from zero to market with limited resources. Someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is comfortable navigating highly technical environments. Nice to have qualities are an interest in developing product operations and practices, as the product organization is growing fast.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* **Drive a product vertical end-to-end:** define its vision, evidence, GTM strategy,, and execution across all related product pillars, taking full accountability from discovery through launch and beyond.
* **Build and scale products:** identify opportunities, validate customer problems, translate complex technical requirements into product solutions, and bring new capabilities from concept to market.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Exein platform and its core products (Analyzer and Runtime), setting new standards for quality, security coverage, and user experience.
* Act as the voice of the customer — firmware engineers, security teams, and compliance owners — ensuring customer insights and market needs directly inform product decisions.
* Define and drive product strategy across key areas such as CVE detection and remediation, SBOM and compliance workflows (including CRA readiness), and fleet-wide runtime protection.
* Work hands-on with Engineering, Security Research, AI, Sales, Marketing, and Go-to-Market teams to translate product vision into clear priorities, technical requirements, and successful releases.
* Collaborate closely with the CTO, head of product, and the rest of the product Team at Exein's Rome HQ, ensuring alignment across product strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution.
* Navigate technical complexity and competing priorities, making sound product decisions in fast-moving environments with limited resources.
* Continuously improve user journeys across the platform, from firmware upload to vulnerability analysis and incident triage.
* Define and monitor product KPIs, measuring adoption, engagement, retention, and business impact.

**Requirements**
----------------


* **Mandatory: Previous experience in a cybersecurity context .** We are looking for someone who has experienced the challenges of building and scaling cybersecurity products.
* **5+ years of relevant product experience**, ideally as a **founder, first/sole Product Manager, or early product leader** with significant end-to-end ownership.
* Proven track record of taking products from zero to market, building with limited resources, and making high-impact decisions independently.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity products, ideally in B2B environments, with the ability to engage credibly with security engineers and technical stakeholders.
* Strong technical fluency and the ability to understand complex architectures, software development processes, and embedded/Linux systems concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to own a product vertical and drive multiple interconnected roadmap pillars from discovery to delivery and launch.
* Highly autonomous, entrepreneurial, and execution-oriented mindset. Comfortable operating without predefined processes and creating structure where needed.
* Proven ability to work closely with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, define scope, and drive delivery.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS context
* Proven ability to integrate agentic / AI tools into the product management practice
* Experience with making AI-first products or releasing AI/agentic features in a real product
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical teams, executive stakeholders, and customers.
* English fluency is mandatory.
* Based in Europe and available to occasionally travel to Exein's headquarters in Rome, Italy.

#### ***Nice to have***


* Experience in physical AI, embedded security, IoT security, device security, or product security.
* Understanding of firmware build systems (Yocto, Buildroot), containers, or kernel-level technologies such as eBPF.
* Experience applying AI capabilities within technical product workflows.
* Experience scaling a cybersecurity product from early-stage development to enterprise adoption.

**Why join us**
---------------


* Drive a strategic product vertical and directly influence its vision, delivery , and market success.
* Work on complex, technically challenging products addressing a rapidly evolving market.
* Operate with autonomy, make meaningful product decisions, and see your work translate into products used by customers worldwide.
* Collaborate with engineers, security researchers, commercial teams, and product leaders who are passionate about building world-class technology.
* Work closely with the head of product and CTO at our Rome HQ while helping scale Exein's product capabilities across Europe and beyond.

Work at Europe's latest unicorn
* Contribute to a company building the next generation of embedded and device security.


**Location:** Europe **-** Occasional travel to Rome (HQ), Italy


**Salary range:** €60-80K

  

*Exein is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We evaluate all applications fairly regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, background, or orientation.*

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Company Description**  

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?


With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Data Analyst, you'll have many opportunities to try things you've never done before.


IKEA Supply is responsible for the supply chain strategy, supply planning and logistics services that ensure IKEA products are available to customers around the world in a cost efficient, sustainable way. Every day, we strive to make our supply chain smarter, faster and more resilient.


You will belong to the Supply Data & Analytics team, reporting to the Data & Analytics Manager. We are enabling data democratisation through scalable self-service capabilities and AI enablement, while ensuring high quality, timely and cost efficient data solutions that support IKEA Supply in making more informed and effective business decisions.


Our Analyst team is based in Älmhult. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.

 **Job Description**  

As a Data Analyst, you'll play an important part in the team and bring valuable IKEA and supply chain knowledge into a new setting. The Data Analyst function supports the transformation of IKEA Supply into a more data driven organisation by extracting and sharing deep insights from complex internal and external data sources. It enables cross functional data product teams to make evidence-based decisions through advanced data exploration, analysis, visualisation, performance measurement and hypothesis testing, ultimately improving supply chain performance and delivering a better customer experience. The impact of our work continues to resonate in homes and hearts across the world.


On a typical working day, you will:

* Understand business requirements in depth and work closely with the product team to interpret and enhance them, shaping how the data products should be designed and delivered.
* Ensure and promote data informed decision making to improve business performance, working within cross functional data product teams.
* Ensure solutions continuously deliver value to IKEA Supply by working closely with stakeholders across different functions and adapting to evolving business needs.
* Evaluate the usability and potential of structured internal and external data sources for product analytics and data driven decision making.
* Write complex SQL queries to extract, transform and load data as part of robust data processing pipelines, using joins, nesting and advanced operations.
* Conduct advanced data exploration and analysis using modern data mining techniques (including machine learning) and visualisation tools to generate actionable insights.
* Build and maintain scalable analytics and insight products in Power BI, translating business needs into technical requirements and compelling data stories.
* Apply AI assisted tools (for example Copilot style coding assistants and agent-based workflows) to accelerate SQL development, automate data quality checks, and review and validate code, while using good judgement on when and how to use them responsibly.
* Promote agile ways of working, performance measurement, hypothesis testing and OKRs.

  

**Qualifications**  

What we'd like you to bring to the table


The role as a Data Analyst requires you to have:

* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* 4+ years' experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, ideally within a supply chain, logistics or manufacturing environment.
* A strong ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements, helping product teams interpret needs and design fit for purpose solutions.
* Expertise in building scalable visualisation products (for example Power BI), with a good ability to translate business needs into actionable data solutions and storytelling driven dashboards.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including use of notebook environments to analyse data, share insights and enable reproducible workflows. Ability to read and understand object orientated programming languages (ideally Python & Pyspark) is also a requirement.
* A strong understanding of data mining techniques and data exploration across large datasets to support decision making and uncover business opportunities.
* A solid foundation in probability and statistics, including hypothesis testing and experimental design (for example A/B testing) to validate business hypotheses.
* Experience with data engineering concepts and end to end data pipelines, with the ability to understand the full lifecycle from raw data sources to business insight (for example cloud data platforms such as Databricks and modelling with dbt).
* Familiarity with collaborative software engineering practices (Agile, DevOps, version control) and data product development principles focused on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of AI powered development tools and coding agents (for example GitHub Copilot or equivalents) for writing, reviewing and validating code, with an understanding of their capabilities, limitations and responsible use in a data governance context.


It's a plus if you also:

* Have experience shipping data products at scale in a large enterprise or complex matrixed organisation.
* Have experience partnering with Data & Digital Product Leaders (or equivalent)
* Have applied generative AI or agent based workflows to automate data analysis, testing or documentation.

  

**Additional Information**  

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity.

**This team is located in Älmhult, Sweden. We regret that we are unable to handle applications made by e-mail.** We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than **13** **Dec. 2026****.**


At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You're welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe and what you look like. We don't even care how you have furnished your home. We're interested in you simply because you're you. Even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people's different perspectives, backgrounds and personalities make us better at understanding our customers' dreams and needs.


For more information about the position, please contact **Hiring Manager Data & Analytics Manager Ross Clabburn** at ross.clabburn@inter.ikea.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact **People & Culture Specialist Katie Pettersson** at katie.pettersson2@inter.ikea.com.


We are looking forward to hearing from you soon!

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
***Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world feel your work.***


As a **Senior Analytics Engineer**, you'll join an embedded, AI-native Data & Analytics team that sits inside the commercial and product domains driving our growth. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Revenue Operations, Global Sales Leadership, Customer Success and B2B Marketing as we scale our enterprise business, and you are the architect of the self-improving system that is our B2B data stack, from source to the interfaces Sales, Marketing and RevOps use. You bring the engineering expertise to build it, a clear view of how data flows from source to those interfaces, and the business intuition to advocate for data as a strategic asset. You'll have a dedicated mandate in the Enterprise GTM org while drawing on the shared infrastructure, engineering support and peers of our central Data & Analytics team.


Our B2B business covers the full range of customers: businesses that subscribe online to our Business plan, small and mid-sized businesses supported by our sales team, and mid-market and enterprise customers (brands, agencies and media platforms) with dedicated account teams. Many of these start out as individual creators on Epidemic Sound. A key part of the role is connecting product usage with CRM data, so we can see which users and teams belong to a business and when they're ready for a sales conversation.

**Your key responsibilities include**

* Build trusted B2B data models. Tested, version-controlled models on BigQuery from Salesforce and product sources, built with AI coding tools.
* Own the metrics. The semantic models and definitions behind our key B2B metrics (ARR, NRR/GRR, churn, renewals and pipeline), plus a few canonical dashboards for RevOps.
* Design the stack as a system. Bring in new sources with Data Platform, ship instrumentation to the product codebase, and own monitoring in production.
* Partner with RevOps, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing leadership. Work out which decisions data should unlock, and do the analysis yourself when it is the quickest route.
* Make the warehouse ready for agents and self-serve. Context, semantic layer, metadata and skills, with agents reading the semantic layer first and canonical datasets next.
* Enable others to do data work. Templates, conventions and teaching so analysts and GTM teams can build well themselves.
* Safeguard quality. Evals on agent answers, a feedback loop that improves the system, and standards and guardrails for access, personal data and cost.

**Requirements**

* Senior-level ownership and influence. You have owned a data domain end to end and shaped decisions at the leadership level.
* Strong SQL, data modelling and dbt on BigQuery. You design clean, well-tested models in a production dbt project, with Git, code review, CI and Python, and choose the simplest approach that does the job.
* An AI-native way of working. You use AI coding tools daily and understand context engineering and evals well enough to judge when an agent's answer can be trusted.
* Stakeholder skills and business intuition. You ask what decision someone needs to make, explain modelling choices to technical and non-technical colleagues, and advocate for using data well.
* A system mindset. You understand how data components fit together and where a change will ripple.
* Sound judgement and documentation habits. You write things down clearly, take ownership, and know when a simple answer is enough.

**it would also be music to our ears if you have:**

* Experience across the B2B GTM funnel, with Sales, Marketing and RevOps, and with CRM data such as Salesforce.
* Experience with a semantic layer such as dbt MetricFlow.
* Experience with Hex or similar notebook tools, and with orchestration such as Airflow or Cloud Composer.
* Experience from a scale-up or a 0 to 1 commercial motion, where you owned data products through fast-changing requirements.

**Equal opportunity employer**  

We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.

**Application**  

Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
### **About Enity Bank Group**


Since 2005, we’ve been challenging the Nordic mortgage market by thinking differently – and more inclusively. We exist for those who often fall between the cracks of the traditional banking system, offering sustainable and responsible mortgages that truly make a difference.


Enity is a listed company with strong brands including Bluestep Bank, Bank2 and 60plusbanken. Together, we operate in Sweden, Norway and Finland, helping people enter the housing market, re-mortgage expensive debt, or save safely and smartly.


At Enity, you’ll be part of challenging conventions, driving change, and creating real value. We believe that the combination of courage, care and innovation can create meaningful impact – both for our customers and for you as a colleague.


Want to help shape the future of banking? You’ll feel right at home at Enity.

### **About the role**


We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our Onboarding team and help us build and improve the digital services used by our customers across the Nordics.


In this role, you’ll work across the entire stack, combining backend development in .NET and C# with frontend development in Angular and TypeScript. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of their work, and is excited about using AI to build better software.

**What you’ll be doing**


As part of our cross-functional team, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable applications in a modern, cloud-based environment. You’ll work on both customer-facing applications and the backend services supporting them, collaborating closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to deliver reliable and intuitive digital experiences.


You’ll also contribute to technical decisions, improve existing solutions, and explore how AI can make our development process more efficient.

**Tech stack**


We work in a modern fullstack environment:

* **Backend:** .NET, C#, microservices, RabbitMQ and REST APIs
* **Frontend:** Angular and TypeScript
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Azure, Kubernetes and Docker
* **CI/CD:** GitHub and GitHub Actions
* **AI-assisted development:** GitHub Copilot and Claude Code

### **About you**


More than anything, we’re looking for the right person. You’re an experienced fullstack engineer who has spent significant time working with both .NET/C# and Angular/TypeScript. You’re equally comfortable building backend services as you are developing customer-facing applications.


But technical experience is only part of it. You’re curious, pragmatic, and proactive. You want to understand why something works, not just that it does. You take ownership, challenge existing solutions when needed, and bring ideas forward rather than waiting for someone to assign them.


You’re already using AI in your daily development, or you’re eager to explore its potential. You enjoy sharing knowledge, learning from others, and collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Experience from financial services is a plus, but not required. The right mindset is.

**Why you’ll love working here**


You’ll have ownership and impact across the entire stack, working on solutions that make a real difference for our customers.


As a challenger bank, decisions can move faster than at larger organizations, and engineers have a direct voice in what we build and how we build it.


We believe in an office-first culture, with the flexibility needed to balance work and life. You’ll have opportunities to grow, explore new technologies, and be part of a team that values collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

### **Sounds Interesting?**


We would be happy to see your application as soon as possible, as the selection is ongoing.


Please note that a valid work permit for Sweden is required for this position.

**Also note that this recruitment is managed by our external partner Safemind. All applications are submitted via Safemind's application form when you click** ***Apply*****.**

description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

Artificial intelligence is opening up new possibilities across our business. Our ambition goes beyond exploring what AI can do: we want to turn the right opportunities into solutions that make a real difference to how we work.  



  

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join our AI Infusion Team within Atlas Copco Industrial Technique. Working where technology meets the business, you will help teams turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable solutions used in everyday work. The role suits someone who enjoys moving between business challenges, technology and people. You will report to Business Area AI Architect , based in Sweden.  



**Your mission**  

Take prioritized AI initiatives from use-case discovery through pilot to production, delivering measurable workflow impact and reusable AI assets. Success is measured by business outcomes, not by the number of proofs of concept.  



  

Make the technical decisions on discovery, solution design and build approach within AI Core standards, and recommend whether to scale, reshape, merge or stop an initiative.
  

Own technical delivery, production readiness, adoption enablement and field feedback, while the business product owner owns the business case, value KPIs and outcomes. You will also support local AI business needs with technical questions, and promote best practices.


**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

* **Discover and frame:** work closely with business teams to understand workflows, users, data and the outcomes that matter; test each initiative against owner, data and value gates; and turn ambiguity into a focused MVP scope, architecture and adoption path.
* **Build and productionize:** prototype and ship LLM applications, AI agents, retrieval and knowledge systems, and workflow automation; integrate them with enterprise data, APIs and identity; and build in observability and cost control.
* **Secure and govern:** design for security, privacy, compliance and human accountability; evaluate quality against clear acceptance criteria; and agree release, operations and support handover with IT, platform, security and data owners.
* **Drive adoption:** coach product owners, engineers, key users and local AI champions; track usage and business KPIs; and support change management so the receiving team can run and improve the solution.
* **Scale the practice:** advise local business teams on AI technical questions and prompt best practices; package reusable components, evaluations, patterns and playbooks as governed AI assets; feed field insights back to the central AI hub; and share knowledge through demos, mentoring and learning sessions.
**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

We are not looking for one specific career path; we are interested in what you can do. This reflects the Group's skills-enabled approach, which values capabilities over current job titles.  



**Here is what we are looking for:**

* Proven delivery of at least one AI, ML, LLM or agentic solution into production, with real-user adoption and a measurable business result.
* Strong hands-on coding skills.
* Practical knowledge of agents and orchestration, context engineering, guardrails and evaluation.
* Experience with cloud-native architecture, APIs and enterprise system integration; Azure, Power Platform, Databricks, SAP or PTC experience is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data, identity, security, privacy, governance and AI cost management.
* High agency and a builder's mindset – you create the first useful artifact without waiting for perfect requirements.
* Structured problem solving and sound judgment in balancing speed, quality, risk, cost and reuse.
* Ability to influence without formal authority and to lead business and architecture conversations in English across functions and cultures.
* Business curiosity and collaboration – you learn new domains quickly, coach others and keep accountable stakeholders informed.
**Your compensation and benefits**
----------------------------------

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.  



Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.


**Your job location**
---------------------

The role has a European scope and is based in **Sickla, Nacka, Sweden** , with hybrid working. Travel to business sites in Europe is required when initiatives call for it.


**Why it is great to work with us**
-----------------------------------

Help shape how AI moves from possibility to practical business value across Industrial Technique.  



* **High-impact work** – solve real industrial challenges with AI and influence how teams operate, make decisions and solve problems.
* **Broad exposure** – work with cross-functional teams across Europe and beyond, close to both technology and the business.
* **Freedom to explore** – shape how solutions are discovered, designed and delivered within our AI standards, with real ownership.
* **A new and growing global team** – help build the team from the start, with significant room for personal growth and career impact.

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

description:

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) delivers the infrastructure that powers Microsoft’s cloud services. The EMEA Data Centre Delivery (DCD) team leads the end-to-end Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) delivery of data centers across the region. The Microsoft portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.


We are seeking a Construction Project Manager to lead our team in the development in Gävle, Sweden,


As the Construction Project Manager**,** you will lead the campus development by delivering multiple concurrent hyperscale DCs. The successful candidate must be prepared to support multiple site locations as needed, with the role expected to be primarily site based.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead the safe, secure, compliant, and predictable delivery of the Gävle Metro portfolio, currently covering six concurrent data center projects at different stages of design, construction, commissioning, and turnover.

* Lead and develop a high-performing, inclusive organization, ensuring the right leadership, resources, capabilities, and delivery partners are in place as the Metro continues to grow.
* Provide technical and constructability leadership, resolve complex cross-project dependencies, and drive improvements, standardization, recovery, or acceleration plans where required.

title: Data Center Project Manager
description:
**Overview**  

As a Microsoft Data Center Project Manager (DCPM), you will perform troubleshooting for service incidents, manage assigned projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing best practices.


Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.


Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.


With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals.
